title: Access Tunnel
summary: A narrow concrete tunnel slopes upward, its walls lined with faded utility conduits and a single operational emergency hatch.
arrival_narration: You step through the gate and into a sloping tunnel, the air thick with the scent of ozone and rust. A single emergency hatch—marked with a red circle—flanks the wall to your right. A keypad beside it glows faintly. A loose conduit pipe lies half-buried in the dust near your feet, and a flickering maintenance placard warns of ‘unauthorized access voids.’ The tunnel’s ceiling curves upward, revealing a single overhead light fixture that hums weakly.
